text: Binary: whether at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP) directly quotes wording from the OP's title or argument (reference text), verbatim or near-verbatim reproduced OP text, typically in quotation marks or block-quote formatting, matching available OP text. Endorsement or refutation not required (agree, disagree or merely reproduce). Output 1 if any comment does; 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment quotes OP text. Paraphrase without reproduced wording, quotes of other sources/users, and quotations not matching OP text don't count. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, in argument or comments (neither quote source nor evidence); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Uses current supplied text including marked edits, subject to that exclusion. Null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both OP title and argument are missing.
